d: We are currently hiring for a Chief Finance Officer (CFO) for a fast-growing, Capital Markets Authority (CMA)-regulated fintech and financial services organisation based in Kuwait.
Relocation: Candidates currently based across the GCC region will be considered.

The CFO will be a key member of the executive leadership team, responsible for driving the organisation's financial strategy, overseeing the finance function, ensuring regulatory compliance and supporting business growth and expansion.
The role requires a strategic finance leader with strong technical expertise, commercial acumen and proven experience within regulated financial services, fintech or capital markets.
q: Minimum 12+ years of progressive finance experience, including at least 3–5 years in a C-suite or equivalent senior leadership position.
Proven experience as CFO, Deputy CFO, VP Finance or equivalent within a regulated financial services, fintech or capital markets organisation.
Strong and current knowledge of Kuwait CMA regulations, financial compliance and regulatory reporting.
Demonstrated experience building and leading finance teams in a high-growth business environment.
Strong expertise in financial reporting, treasury, budgeting, forecasting, internal controls and capital planning.
Experience presenting to boards, investors and regulators.
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related discipline.
CA, ACCA, CPA, CFA or equivalent professional qualification.
Direct experience working with or reporting to the Kuwait CMA.
Exposure to US-listed equities, ETFs, brokerage platforms or multi-market capital markets products.
Experience supporting IPOs, fundraising, M&A and investor relations.
Bilingual proficiency in Arabic and English.
Strong regulatory understanding and governance expertise.
Proven team leadership and organisational development.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
High levels of integrity, accountability and resilience.
r: Define and drive the overall financial strategy aligned with business objectives.
Lead financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, long-term financial modelling and capital allocation.
Build, develop and lead a high-performing finance function.
Partner with the CEO, founders and board on strategic business decisions.
Ensure compliance with Kuwait Capital Markets Authority (CMA) regulations and financial reporting requirements.
Oversee regulatory filings, disclosures and statutory submissions.
Manage relationships with regulators, external auditors, legal counsel and regulatory advisors.
Monitor regulatory developments and strengthen internal compliance policies and controls.
Oversee treasury, cash management, banking relationships and financial reconciliations.
Establish and maintain robust internal financial controls.
Manage liquidity, currency, credit and operational financial risks.
Ensure accuracy and integrity of financial statements and reporting systems.
Lead financial reporting and presentations to the board and investors.
Support fundraising, capital raising, M&A and strategic partnership activities.
Oversee financial due diligence and investment modelling.
Build relationships with existing and prospective investors.
Lead implementation and optimisation of financial systems and reporting infrastructure.
Improve financial processes, automation and reporting capabilities.
Partner with Technology and Operations teams on financial integrations and settlement processes.
Support new product launches and geographical expansion through sound financial planning.

d: Are you a dynamic and results-driven hospitality professional with a passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences? Look no further! Join us as the Director of Rooms and lead our talented team in creating a welcoming and comfortable environment for our valued guests. Bring your high energy, enthusiasm, and commitment to excellence, and be a driving force in shaping memorable stays and exceeding guest expectations. If you thrive in a fast-paced, guest-centric environment and have a proven track record in rooms management, we want you on our team!

The Director of Rooms is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the Rooms Division, ensuring exceptional guest experiences, and maintaining high service and operational standards. This role includes managing the Front Office, Housekeeping, Guest Services, Concierge, Laundry, Recreation/Spa , driving revenue opportunities, and fostering a culture of excellence in hospitality.
q: Champion the Park Hyatt brand ethos of understated luxury and personalized service.
Oversee all aspects of the guest journey from pre-arrival to departure, ensuring seamless coordination between hotel and resort services.
Lead service recovery for VIPs and high-profile guests, ensuring issues are resolved promptly and elegantly.
Monitor guest satisfaction metrics (e.g., Medallia, LQA, Forbes) and continuously elevate service standards.
Manage daily operations of Front Office, Housekeeping, Concierge, Spa/Wellness, Laundry, and support integration with Golf & Yacht Club guest services.
Optimize workflows and SOPs to deliver consistency and operational efficiency.
Lead departmental heads in maintaining brand standards across all guest-facing areas.
Ensure adherence to all internal Hyatt policies, brand standards, SOPs, and audit requirements related to guest services, operations, and colleague conduct.
Develop and manage the Rooms Division’s annual budget and forecasts.
Control labor costs, operating expenses, and capital improvements aligned with business strategy.
Maximize revenue through room inventory management, upselling, and ancillary services.
Lead, coach, and inspire a high-performing Rooms team.
Ensure all colleagues are trained in Forbes/Park Hyatt service standards and operational procedures.
Drive Hyatt’s "Care for People" culture by supporting colleague well-being, recognition, and career development.
Contribute to the hotel’s Executive Committee with strategic input on guest experience, service innovation, and operational planning.
Collaborate with Sales, Events, F&B, Engineering, and Golf operations to ensure a unified guest experience across the estate.
Lead initiatives tied to Hyatt’s Ways of Working (WoW), DEI, and sustainability goals.
Ensure full compliance with Dubai Municipality and UAE regulatory standards related to hygiene, health, and safety.
Oversee emergency and crisis management procedures within the Rooms Division.
Bachelor’s degree in hospitality management or equivalent. Master’s or executive education is a plus.
Minimum 5 years of progressive rooms leadership experience in luxury hospitality, preferably in resort or mixed-use environments.
Prior experience in leading large-scale operations with integrated wellness, leisure, and lifestyle components.
Expertise in Opera PMS, HotSOS, and other Hyatt systems is preferred.
Strong financial acumen with proven budget and cost control experience.
High emotional intelligence, cultural sensitivity, and guest-centric mindset.
Fluent in English; knowledge of other EU languages.

d: Position Title: Regulatory Compliance Analyst (2 Openings)
Contract Type: 1-Year Contract, renewable based on performance (secondment basis)
Compensation: Around BHD 1,000 per month, all-inclusive, depending on skills and qualifications
Our Client is a bank in Bahrain looking for two Regulatory Compliance professionals to join on secondment.
You will read the Central Bank of Bahrain (CBB) Rulebook, turn its requirements into clear actions, and work with the bank's teams and systems to keep the bank compliant.
q: 2 or more years of experience in regulatory compliance, preferably in banking or financial services.
Able to read regulations and convert them into practical requirements.
Understanding of how central bank regulation works and which departments are involved.
Strong communication skills and the ability to coordinate across departments.
Good analytical, documentation, and reporting skills.
Comfortable learning and using the bank's own compliance systems.
Experience with CBB regulations is an advantage, but not mandatory.
Must be eligible to work in Bahrain and available onsite for the full contract.
Send your CV to talent.me@leadingedgeme.ae with the position title in the subject line.
r: Read and interpret the CBB Rulebook, directives, and circulars that apply to the bank's licence type.
Break regulations into clear, actionable requirements and map them to the bank's policies and controls.
Cover core CBB areas such as high-level controls and the compliance function, financial crime (AML/CFT), business and market conduct, and operational risk, including cyber security.
Identify the departments affected and work with them to put each requirement in place.
Use the bank's existing compliance systems to track, monitor, and report compliance.
Support regulatory reporting, CBB reviews, and audits.
Keep gap assessments and action plans up to date.
